name: First State DME
old_description: At First State DME, we offer an extensive line of medical equipment to fit almost anyones needs.  We service all of Delaware and surrounding areas and offer free delivery on certain items and quantities!  Browse what we have to offer online or come in to check out our show room.  We supply to the public and also accept certain insurance policies.
about:
First State DME operates from Dover, Delaware, where it runs a showroom and service center at 4115 N. Dupont Highway. The company serves the entire state of Delaware and surrounding areas with medical equipment and supplies.

The business provides a range of services including medical equipment sales, rentals, delivery, and repair. It also offers prosthetics and orthotics services at its Dover location and through mobile appointments across the region. Financing options are available for customers.

Customers include individual patients, healthcare providers, and insurance carriers. The company accepts certain insurance policies and workers’ compensation claims, and supplies home medical equipment, orthotic bracing, inserts, shoes, and related devices such as wheelchairs, hospital beds, and respiratory equipment.

First State DME emphasizes customer service and competitive pricing. It differentiates itself with free delivery on qualifying orders, in-house repair technicians, and a showroom where customers can evaluate products before purchase.
